product_metadata.title: 60Pcs Natural Dried Pampas Grass, Pampas Grass Decor - Pampas Grass Bouquet Including White Pampas Grass, Brown Pampas, Bunny Tails Pampas Grass, Pampas Grass Plants for Home Christmas Decoration
features: 【Rich Package Contents】The pampas grass plants package including 10pcs white pampas grass, 10pcs brown pampas, 10pcs bunny tails pampas grass, 30pcs floating dust. Dried pampas grass decor to create a warm, welcome, romantic atmosphere.

【Natural Dried Flower】 Our pampas grass are made from 100% natural high-quality pampas, natural colors, plump feathers, non-toxic and harmless. We retain dried pampas grass original color and the feathers are full and even. Natural fluffy pampas grass does not need to daily care and pruning, which is suitable for all seasons. Here you can feel the charm of nature.

【Warm Notice】Due to the transport ,the dried pampas bouquet can lose some volume and fluffiness. You can put the pampas grass under the sun for few hours to make it fluffy after receiving the item. It is normal about shedding because dried pampas grass is natural pampas grass plants (Once it's in the vase, it will be fine and will last for 2-3 years).

【DIY Design】Pampas grass is approximately 18 inch high and the stems are approximately 0.75 inch wide, you can also cut them to suit the shape of your pampas grass vase . It is suitable for any place decoration, add fun to the room or space, bring you a good mood.

【Elegant Pampas Decor】Pampas grass decor is very suitable for beautify exotic restaurant tables, also can decorate ceremonies such as parties, parties, family gatherings, weddings, birthday parties, adaptable to a wide range of scenes, can also be used as a housewarming gift or door-to-door gift for friends.
